text:
ana: Quick sync 1-week refkit lab series2 — goal: three short tutorials, one compact refkit release, a reproducible benchmark blurb, and a single office-hour. Need owners for copy, repo assets, benchmark, LP, and routing. Who's in?

toby: I can own the repo & refkit packaging. Plan: ship a tiny mono-repo with `examples/`, a `README.md` quickstart, and 3 demo notebooks. Will include a 3-line CLI quickstart.

ke: I'll run the bench harness and produce one hero stat + reproducible CSV and a tiny `repro.sh` script. Tentative compare: default vs caching+batching on 300-token demo.

sylvie: I'll do the landing page variants and the promo visuals. Two hero angles: code-first (terminal GIF + CTA "Run the refkit") and story-first (stat strip + CTA "See the results"). Can mock by EOD.

pat: I'll handle email and inbound routing. Segments: OSS contributors, trials (>5k tokens), and partners. Plan drip: announce -> tutorial -> office-hour -> replay. Add maintainers microflow for >2 repo contributions.

ana: (typo) ana meant to say please add owners summary at the end.

ana: Ana again: Bench language needs to be conservative: "up to ~30% unit cost reduction on our sample workload" and always link to reproducibles. Also include p99 latency note.

ke: infra ask: 120 GPU minutes to sweep 3 models. Approve?

pat: Approved 120 GPU minutes. Please log usage under GH issue `refkit-labseries-bench`.

toby: Repo plan: `refkit-labseries/` with `examples/quickstart`, `benchmarks/` and a single `Makefile`. CLI hero snippet: ```bash
ri refkit quickstart --example=chat
``` Will add short GIF of that running.

sylvie: Design note: hero A will have animated terminal GIF; hero B will have a compact stat strip (median, p99, cost/token). A/B test CTAs: "Run the refkit" vs "See benchmark details".

ke: I'll attach CSV + `repro.sh` and a small Python plotting script. Hero stat likely: "~28% lower unit cost with batching + cache" (final after runs).

pat: Routing detail: add UTM tags and a CRM webhook. If registrant has repo stars > 1 or contributions > 0, route to maintainer stream with early-access CTA. Partners get a separate invite.

ana: Copy ask: keep the hero one-liner to one sentence and readable by non-devs. Add a short subhead for devs linking to the repo.

toby: Publishing plan: small refkit release (v0.1.0), tag repo, create release notes with a short benchmark excerpt and a `HOWTO_REPRODUCE.md`. Will open PR for review tomorrow.

sylvie: Mockups ETA: EOD. Will include GIFs sized for LP hero and social clips (15s).

ke: One blocker: need access to an extra region for a model variant test. Who can open infra request?

pat: I'll file the infra request and follow up. Also will set registration cap to 350 for the office-hour and enable recording.

publish-bot: Reminder set: create GH issue "refkit-labseries-launch-playbook" and assign owners in 12 hours.

ana: Owners recap: toby = repo & assets, ke = benchmark & reproducibles, sylvie = LP & visuals, pat = email & routing, ana = overall PM. Post any blockers on the GH issue. :rocket:

toby: One small ask: can marketing ops approve $400 social promo for week-of?

pat: Approved $400. Track via UTMs and short links.

ke: Will run the sweep tonight and post interim numbers here.

sylvie: Uploading mock GIFs and LP copy to Figma now. Link to follow in the issue.

ana: Thanks everyone 1et's aim to freeze copy/design by Thursday. If anything slips, update the GH issue.

publish-bot: Reminder: scheduled social posts drafted for review in #marketing-drafts in 48h.
